title: A perfect gift for a movie night (white Meltie mug, in bed) — one-shot test
notes: One-shot test of the pipeline (white variant, new setting): the treats on a wooden bed tray on a cream duvet in a bedroom, an upholstered headboard with pillows and a glowing bedside lamp behind, instead of the white desk, red wall and Christmas tree. WHITE variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug. The pour and the last shot spill chocolate on purpose (brief). Laptop: green screen with original generated stills of a fictional 1980s series; plain unbranded red foil bag; Sora audio.

product.name: Meltie Mug Mini Fondue Mug, white
product.description: the WHITE Meltie Mini Fondue Mug exactly as in the product photos: glossy off-white ceramic body that flares wider at the top, a glossy dark chocolate-brown glazed interior, 'Chocolate...' in brown cursive script with a small brown swirl mark on the front, a tall arched opening at the base for a tealight, an angular white handle on the right, and a fondue fork with a brown handle and long steel tines that clips into a slot in the handle

style: Cosy movie night at home in the evening, in BED: everything happens on a wooden bed tray on a cream duvet, an upholstered headboard and pillows behind; a dim warm room, deep soft shadows, warm amber lamp light, no bright studio light, no red wall, no Christmas tree. Handheld vertical phone video at bed-tray height, shallow depth of field, rich warm colour grade. Hands have long glossy dark-grey manicured nails. The laptop screen is always flat chroma-key green. No on-screen text, no logos.

shots.prompt: One continuous static take, no camera move. 0-0.8 s: the fork lifts the white marshmallow up from the board and moves it over the brim-full mug. 0.8-1.8 s: it pushes the marshmallow straight DOWN INTO the mug until it disappears under the melted chocolate; the chocolate surges up and OVERFLOWS: a big wave of glossy melted chocolate spills over the rim on all sides and pours down the white outside of the mug in thick streams. 1.8-2.3 s: the marshmallow stays under while thick chocolate keeps pouring down the outside of the mug and pools in a puddle on the bed tray around its base. 2.3-3.5 s: it rises slowly straight back up out of the mug, fully coated in glossy brown chocolate, dripping, while the overflow keeps running down the mug into the growing puddle. 3.5-4 s: held still just above the mug. The marshmallow stays on the fork the whole time. Lots of spilled chocolate.
